facts.claim: Bring identification and proof of household members, income and address for Emergency Assistance. The page does not specify which document types are accepted; call Service Link at 859-491-8303 extension 2300 to check.
quote: Identification and proof of household members, income, and address.
For more information please contact Service Link (859) 491-8303 ext. 2300

facts.claim: The current Emergency Assistance page lists Monday 11–4 for Campbell and Kenton County residents seeking emergency food, diapers or hygiene items. Confirm hours before travelling, especially around holidays.
facts.quote: On Mondays from 11-4 for Campbell and Kenton County residents needing emergency food, diapers, or hygiene items.

facts.claim: Tuesday and Thursday hours are listed as 12:30–4:30 for help with housing, employment and benefit enrollment; customers can also shop in the emergency choice food pantry during those sessions.
facts.quote: On Tuesdays and Thursdays from 12:30 - 4:30 for customers needing resources such as housing, employment, and benefit enrollments. Customers also have the opportunity to shop for food in our emergency choice food pantry.

facts.claim: Wednesday food assistance is listed from 11–4 for people aged 55 or older from Campbell and Kenton Counties. This is the Wednesday session’s eligibility, not a claim that all pantry service is age-restricted.
facts.quote: On Wednesday from 11-4 for Seniors aged 55 and up from Campbell and Kenton Counties needing food assistance.

facts.claim: Morning Emergency Assistance appointments are offered Monday–Friday, 8:30 a.m.–12:30 p.m. Call 859-491-8303 extension 2301 to schedule; the general Service Link number uses extension 2300.
quote: If you would like to schedule an appointment for Emergency Assistance Monday through Friday 8:30 a.m. - 12:30 p.m.,  please call (859) 491-8303 ext. 2301
For more information please contact Service Link (859) 491-8303 ext. 2300

facts.claim: The Emergency Assistance service list includes a choice food pantry, personal hygiene items and limited help with baby items. Stock, dietary suitability, delivery, proxy shopping and carrying assistance are not established by the reviewed page.
